title: Video Production — Agent 5 → Agent 6 → Agent 7 Contracts
description: Defines: (1) Editing Agent output (produced video), (2) Caption Agent output (captioned video), (3) Quality Control Agent gate checklist. Derived from SCS-001 Charter Article III Agents 5-7.

EditedVideo.description: Agent 5 (Editing) → Agent 6 (Caption). TikTok-ready video sans captions.

file_path.description: Local path to produced video file

loop_ending.description: Whether loop ending technique applied (24-30s reconnects to hook)

pattern_interrupt_count.description: Visual changes throughout video. Min 8 for a 24s video (every 2-3s). No 3-second static holds.

ffmpeg_processing_seconds.description: FFmpeg render time on Mac Mini M4. Target: <= 120s per video.

CaptionedVideo.description: Agent 6 (Caption) → Agent 7 (QC). Video with baked-in captions.

file_path.description: Local path to captioned video file

caption_timing_file.description: Path to caption timing SRT/VTT for platform upload metadata

keyword_highlights.description: Words highlighted in captions (size increase, colour change, bold)

font_size_px.description: Caption font size. Min 48px equivalent per QC gate.

contrast_ratio.description: Caption contrast ratio. Min 4.5:1 per QC gate.

QualityControlGate.description: Agent 7 (QC) gate checklist. ALL items must PASS for publishing.

why_does_this_matter.description: Agent 4's answer is present and substantive

constitutional_filter.description: No fabricated quotes, no misleading claims, no Ethical Shutdown triggers

clip_understandable.description: Core insight understandable without watching source video

failure_reason.description: If failed: specific gate item + reason. Returned to upstream agent.

return_to_agent.description: Which agent to return to for fix. Null if passed.
